notes:
Account background: mid-size payments processor with heavy compliance (PCI + regional finance regulators). Wants an enterprise code assistant integrated into dev IDEs (VS Code, JetBrains) with streaming completions. Requirements fragments:
- Low-latency target: 30-50ms per token for IDE completions; 400 concurrent coding sessions baseline.
- Model/version needs: pin to approved model builds, explicit rollout window, canary + rollback. Must support quantized fallback (e.g., 7B q4) when load spikes.
- Security: SSO/SAML via Okta + SCIM provisioning; audit logs retained 7 years; per-request trace IDs; WORM-style retention for specific artifacts.
- Data residency: US-only for PII-related code; desire for private control plane with optional on-prem inference nodes.
- Cryptography: KMS/HSM with FIPS attestations; TLS peering to VPC; end-to-end encryption for cached KV.
- Observability: per-route latency and token-cost breakdowns; token-level billing in console is a must.
- Contracting: prefers annual Reserved (Dedicated) for dev/prod separation, will pilot Private for sensitive teams.
Call quotes / seller notes: "we can't send production code snippets outside our VPC" — primary blocker for hosted-only offerings.
POC asks: provide an infra workshop, run a 2-week pilot with 50 devs, supply security FAQ + architecture diagram, share a model pinning runbook.
Short-hand: high compliance bar, long procurement, strong interest in Redwood's Private deployment + Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.
use_case_summary: Replace internal completion service with Redwood-powered IDE copilot. Pilot focused on dev productivity (autocompletion, inline documentation generation) with guardrails (model pinning, audit logs). Production to include private VPC endpoints and HSM-backed key management.
purchase_intent: Proof-of-concept Q1 -> Dedicated commitment for dev + Private for regulated squads. Wants pricing for 12-month reserved capacity and add-on for extended audit retention.
notes_short: Must support model pinning & quantized fallbacks
